workflow: Higgsfield MCP nano_banana_pro. PEOPLE: scene-first + 2 refs max + people_theme_anchor. FLATLAY: product_theme_anchor + 3-4 refs.
notes: Valeria Rose Pendant BIHS1145P21: rose gold heart pendant, right half pave diamonds, left half three open rose gold bands, fine rose gold cable chain. Muricelle Bangle BISM0003O14: polished yellow gold hinged bangle with triple-band pave diamond front and smooth gold back. Rohal Huggie BIPM0001H28: gold huggie with white pave diamond bar and rectangular emerald-cut green gem drop. People slots: 2 refs max. Credits: exactly 3 images, count 1 each.

prompt_rules.people_slots: scene first, jewellery second; 2 refs max; people_theme_anchor; negative_prompt_people; count=1; retry only if QA fails
prompt_rules.flatlay: product_theme_anchor OK; 3-4 refs; count=1; match exact SKU from refs
prompt_rules.credits: Exactly 3 images per article (hero+flatlay+lifestyle). No dual variants by default.
prompt_rules.anti_overlay: Do not lead people prompts with commercial/macro jewellery language

higgsfield.people_theme_anchor: Photoreal candid lifestyle photograph, natural skin texture, no illustration, no CGI. Soft natural window light, warm daylight, realistic soft shadows, gentle shallow depth of field. Shot on DSLR, 16:9 full frame with safe margins. People are the primary subject; jewellery is a small worn detail on the body, not a floating product graphic. Entire faces and worn jewellery fully visible, nothing cropped at frame edges.
higgsfield.product_theme_anchor: Photoreal product-in-scene jewellery photograph, HD quality, no distortion of jewellery, identical scale and design, physically accurate metal and stone detail, natural textures only, no stylization, no illustration. Soft natural window light, warm daylight, realistic soft shadows, shallow depth of field. Shot on DSLR, 16:9 full frame with safe margins. Entire jewellery fully visible, nothing cropped at frame edges.
higgsfield.negative_prompt_people: floating jewellery overlay, giant pendant collage, product cutout over people, packshot composited on lifestyle photo, oversized necklace covering torso, graphic drawings, cutouts, product diagrams, split screen, illustration, CGI look, cartoon, fake diamonds, studio HDR glow, unreal scale, oversized jewellery, distorted hands, extra fingers, extra bracelets, extra rings, extra earrings, product shot on plain background, cropped faces, cut-off heads, readable text, logos, dark skin, deep brown skin, heavily tanned skin
higgsfield.negative_prompt: illustration, CGI look, cartoon, fantasy style, over-stylized, plastic glass, fake diamonds, fake gemstones, artificial lighting, studio HDR glow, unreal reflections, blurry jewellery, noise, low detail, AI artifacts, painting, digital art, unreal scale, oversized jewellery, floating overlays, cutouts, product diagrams, readable text, logos, exaggerated proportions
higgsfield.casting_rule: Fair-skinned Indians only for hero/lifestyle (any visible people/skin). Light wheatish to fair North Indian / urban Indian complexion. Flatlay with no people is exempt.

hero.prompt:
Casting (required): fair-skinned Indian woman only. Light wheatish to fair North Indian / urban Indian complexion, clear fair skin tones. Do not use deep brown, dark, or heavily tanned skin.

Republic Day meaning 2027 candid lifestyle photograph, mid-shot of people (not a product ad). A fair-skinned Indian woman in a cream outfit with subtle tricolour accents smiles during a home Republic Day morning with marigold petals and warm festive light softly blurred behind her. Faces and upper body fill most of the frame. She is physically wearing the rose gold heart pendant from reference images (@img1, @img2) on a fine rose gold cable chain around her neck. The Valeria Rose Pendant rests on her upper chest with a soft contact shadow, at real-world necklace size (about 2 to 3 cm heart, small in frame). Camera focuses on the person; jewellery is sharp but NOT the largest object. Design fidelity: rose gold heart, right-side pave diamonds, left-side open triple rose gold bands. ONLY jewellery in the image. Bare ears and bare wrists. CRITICAL: attached to body, never floating cutout / packshot overlay. 16:9 landscape, full face in frame, safe margins.
hero.alt: why republic day is celebrated 2027 hero, fair-skinned Indian woman wearing The Valeria Rose Pendant

flatlay.prompt: Republic Day meaning 2027 top-down flatlay. A lived-in wooden desk with a blank cream greeting card, fountain pen, fresh marigold petals, a small brass bowl, a small tricolour ribbon with no readable text, linen napkin, and a blank dark phone screen fully in frame. The identical yellow gold hinged bangle from (@img1, @img2, @img3, @img4) rests on the surface at natural scale, sharp, full piece visible: The Muricelle Bangle with a polished yellow gold body and a triple-band pave diamond front (exact design fidelity to refs, not a plain thin bangle). Warm window light. No people. No floating overlays or cutouts. No readable text.
flatlay.alt: why republic day is celebrated 2027 flatlay with The Muricelle Bangle

lifestyle.prompt:
Casting (required): fair-skinned Indian woman only. Light wheatish to fair North Indian / urban Indian complexion, clear fair skin tones. Do not use deep brown, dark, or heavily tanned skin.

Republic Day meaning 2027 lifestyle mid-shot. A fair-skinned Indian woman turns slightly in profile during a morning festive gathering. Her ear and cheek are in sharp focus as she physically wears the identical gold huggie drop earring from (@img1, @img2) at natural product scale with a soft contact shadow: The Rohal Huggie Earrings with a white pave diamond bar and a rectangular emerald-cut green gem drop. Jewellery is sharp but small versus the face. This near-side earring is the ONLY jewellery in the image. Bare neck and bare wrists. Never floating packshot overlay. Full face and full earring inside frame with safe margins. Soft morning light, soft patriotic bunting blur behind.
lifestyle.alt: importance of republic day 2027 lifestyle with The Rohal Huggie Earrings
